SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Why aren't you saying anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Don't tell me you plan on staying silent...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Am I someone whose existence is trivial to you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...I just don't know how to phrase it. It's not that you aren't important or anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So that's what my existence is to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Someone about whom you can't find an answer. That's about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...N-Nothing of that sort.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] If so, why can't you come up with an answer?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] T-That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] How could you be trivial to me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmph. Whatever you say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Forget it, even if you're just saying it to humor me... I'm a bit happy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is that so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...However, if that's the case, why are you remaining silent?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's because I don't know how to say it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh really. So you've stumbled onto this situation when you're unable to give an answer.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You truly are a helpless nice guy...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Never thinking about yourself, always jumping into action... That's why you always barge in without first considering what others might think or what

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] kind of situation they are in.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You even try to meddle with things that are beyond your ability.
[FI] ...True, I haven't considered it before... I'm just thinking that being hardworking will certainly bring us somewhere...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Kuh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ......Heh. Seems like I've hit the bulls-eye.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's not over yet, is it? There must still be something we could do?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't it still too early to be giving up? Why can you say that so easily?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...It is as you say. As long as we don't give up, there must be a way. People often say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Though that's the babbling of an ignorant person who doesn't understand anything about the situation...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That is... Certainly, I'm not as knowledgeable as you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] However, for that reason let me say this. As long as we don't lose hope, we'll manage somehow!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Good grief... I really need to learn a little from your unyielding motivation.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Even so, a schedule like this is impossible from the start.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It was very strict from the start, yet a novice like you wants to join in...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It seems to be that way. Whichever wicked gods there be, they are all calling me to give up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...It's not impossible. There's still something we can do, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What else can we do? Try saying it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] L-Like I said, I'll pay for--

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...And I'm telling you that's a nuisance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's a dead end. We don't have any solution. We're like rats driven into a corner.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] There's a saying that goes 'A cornered rat will bite the cat'. Even if it's us...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] We're different from a rat... It is useless to struggle any further.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-How could you put it that way...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Because that's the truth? There's no other solution...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'm sure deep down in your heart you have already given up, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...That's not how I feel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Right. I was certain you would say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] However, I don't need that. I don't care if your meddling is out of good will or kindness, I don't need any of that.
[FI] ...Damn. Isn't there something I could do?
[FI] ......No good. I can't think of anything I could do...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Damn it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's right. Even we can't rise from the verge of death anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's a pity... A Bad End.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Sometimes, peoples' good will can backfire. That's exactly what happened here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...What did I do to make it backfire...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I told you, didn't I? This is my creation, if I'm not happy with it, there's no meaning in doing it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I don't want to continue if I must receive other people's charity.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Charity...? I didn't mean something like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But in the end it became that way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-You're wrong.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It doesn't matter what your intentions were, the situation is as such. I'm not able to do anything and you want to solve that, obviously.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But, my pride won't allow something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'm really grateful for your help. However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] This game of make-believe is hereby over.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...What's with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Don't ask for returns if we are to maintain good relations. What's the difference between this and a child's game of make-believe?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why are you being so masochistic?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...The one unable to answer was you, wasn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's why, the thing that binds us is no more.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hmph... To be more specific, isn't this the same as acting as siblings?
[FI] This girl... is she still worrying about that?
[FI] No, that's not right... She is just giving herself up to despair...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...It's just a little further until we're done, right? Think about it again...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's not what you're thinking for real too, right? It seems like you're just hurting yourself...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Acting...? What's with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But isn't that the case?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It isn't! I told you it's not that way. You can't let this incident make you lose sight of yourself!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Let's just end this already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] End it... end what?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ............Everything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] All the manuscript work we were doing up until now, and also this fake-drama...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's with that!? Was that the extent of your passion?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Was this something so cheap to let it slide using the word 'drama'?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] And yet you call it fake!? Was everything you were doing up until now all fake!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's something yours, and yours alone, right? You called it your own work, right!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't this one of those production hardships you had to go through!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Do I seem hurt? I'm just merely stating a fact.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] If we're not acting like siblings, then I guess we're imitating friendship? It sounds like a childish youth TV drama...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...No... It's not that, you know? You need to calm down a little. Stop joking about this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hehe. That's right... Indeed, it was just nonsense just now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...However, this trouble is all reality.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...But if you don't give up, you can still manage somehow, isn't that right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...That's right. That's my desire... But there are situations that you just can't do anything about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Urgh, enough! When someone is trying to say something constructive, you shut it down immediately!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're just my kouhai, so don't get cocky. Just be quiet and accept your senpai's good-will.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Heh... Now you can't even form decent words, what is it now? You're getting angry at me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's true those words are ones which describes our relationship... But, you won't say that you got involved with me because of those kind of words?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] My only kouhai is you alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're too noisy! Wake up and listen to me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] No. It's all pointless to continue any further.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're my important kouhai!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Heh. Senpai and kouhai? Aren't I just one of the many kouhai that you have?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's not true! You're my only kouhai!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] This has got nothing to do with other people! I'm really worried about you, troubled over your problems, meddling with your issues, all just to see

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] you smile!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's right, at most, the tablet broke. But it is a problem which I as a high-school student can't solve.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I don't have the money, it's absurd to borrow from other people.... It's fatal. I can't do anything at all. It's checkmate.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Fatal, you say....

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] There's no way around it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What are you talking about as if you know everything? Hear what your senpai has to say to you sometimes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hmph... You can't even say decent things now, so you're appealing from that position?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's true that those words are the ones which describes our relationship... But, you won't say that you got involved with me because of those kind of

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] words?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] My only kouhai is you alone!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Wha... Y-You have a lot of other kouhai, don't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, that's right. But the only important kouhai for me is you alone.
